Lattice cryptography is becoming standard on the Internet. Blockchain space reinventing new crypto primitives plainly won’t get as much GPU hours of defense on them.

Use lattice cryptography to secure your NEAR accounts today.

This is how Ethereum exports its assets faster, with high security guarantees for the bridge operator.

The L1 is already the most secure place to hold assets on, it should also be the best place to issue and deploy them from, leveraging the privileged connections between L1, L2s and others.

And guess which asset is at the centre of the L1? Yep, ethereum:native everywhere.
